milestone: WP-02: acknowledged focus, marking and view-change worker commands

review.delivery: One acknowledged local-state change slot. Busy while a page/navigation/change or unread result exists. Pages and other state changes cannot replace accepted commands. Navigation may supersede a change and cancellation cannot undo a committed change. Opaque navigation tickets and worker-validated generation stamps reject stale/foreign work.
review.state: Focus lookup, copy-on-write disk marks, sorting/filtering, bounded page capture and all native-owner retirement run on the serialized worker. Reorder/filter use retained indexed data with original row IDs, focus and marks. Hidden marks remain explicit. No source filesystem mutation or native target inference from display strings.
review.acknowledgment: Typed reply kinds include terminal Fault. NotApplied/Applied/Unknown are independent of display capture. A committed change whose page exceeds a display limit remains Applied; a smaller subsequent read recovers it. Failed commands may supply a current retained-state page without becoming Ready. Terminal faults report Unknown acknowledgment. Native errors retain exact state/domain/code/operation and take precedence over racing cancellation.
